_purpose: Lovett - BoonDog Theatre, visiting the Criterion 14-15 August 2026. A VISITING production: the Criterion is the host venue, not the producer. Company detail lives in visiting_company.json; this file carries the production itself.

title: Lovett
author: Lucy Roslyn
tagline: You may think you already know Mrs Lovett.
_interval_note: ZERO on purpose. Lovett runs straight through - confirmed by Jamie Firth, 2026-08-01. The interval playlist exists to satisfy the pack contract but is never routed.
_image_note: Dark-ground show poster (artwork by Madison Coby). Portrait, for the engine's split-layout poster frame. There is deliberately no full-bleed 16:9 hero - see docs/asset-provenance.md.
synopsis: Newly widowed, Mrs Lovett needs to find a way to survive. Using skills learned from a whaler father, a courtesan mother and a butcher husband, Eleanor "recalibrates" her life - and her relationship with God. An origin story set before her infamous partnership with Sweeney Todd.

cast.name: Lucy Roslyn
cast.note: Written and performed by. Co-founder and Creative Director of BoonDog Theatre.

_cast_note: The `cast` template reads member.role and member.actor - NOT member.name. Both are set here so the slide renders and the data stays readable. A one-person cast list is a thin slide, so the preshow uses the writer template (about-ben, which reads foyer_content.writer) for Lucy instead; `cast` is kept correct in case anything else reads it.
_content_warnings_note: STRUCTURE MATTERS: warning-top3 filters on tier == 'top' and reads .headline and .detail; warning-full selects by .id via item.content.warning_ids. A flat array of strings renders an EMPTY list - it was flat until 2026-08-03 and the slide was silently blank. Keep this shape.
_content_warnings_status: APPROVED. Supplied verbatim by Jamie Firth 2026-08-13 (copy deck B10, 'Just this I think') and set to confidence 'high'. That matters for more than provenance: slide-templates.js warningLine() renders a 'tbc' PILL beside any warning whose confidence is not 'high', so the whole set was rendering with a tbc pill on the public foyer screen while it was draft. Do not reintroduce 'draft' on a live show. DROPPED with Jamie's list: age-guidance (our invention, not his), sex-work and religious-content (subsumed into his own wording). opening-darkness and no-interval are VENUE notices, not company content warnings, and are kept deliberately - both are practical and both are factual.

writer.body: Co-founder and Creative Director of BoonDog Theatre. Lovett premiered at the Edinburgh Festival Fringe in 2025 and has toured the UK ever since - including a preview at the Belgrade, just down the road, in July 2025.
writer.footline: Written and performed by Lucy Roslyn

director.quote: Everyone arrives thinking they know who Mrs Lovett is. The play happens in the gap between that and who she actually was.
director._status: APPROVED by Jamie Firth 2026-08-13. He selected option 1 of the three offered in the copy deck (B6) and asked for the other two to be deleted. This is his chosen wording and is cleared to go on screen.

about_play.headline: Morality becomes a moveable feast
about_play.body: You may think you already know Mrs Lovett, but this new play explores what made her: the brutal choices and disappointments of a life in poverty. When the difference is life or death, morality becomes a moveable feast - and Eleanor is getting hungry...

staging.headline: One performer
staging.body: A butcher's block, a whetstone, a knife, a cup, a hunk of bread. Everything else is Eleanor.

venue.body: The Criterion has staged over 450 productions since 1955, in a building that is over 140 years old - an 1884 Methodist chapel that became a theatre in 1960. It is run entirely by its members: no paid employees, on stage or off.
venue.footline: Registered charity 1161430 • A volunteer-run theatre in Earlsdon, Coventry

volunteer.body: Actors, makers, technicians, front-of-house, bar and box office - every part of the Criterion is volunteer-run, and new members are always welcome. No experience needed to get involved on stage, backstage, or around the building.

foyer_content._visiting_overrides_note: The three blocks below override engine defaults that are written for a Criterion-produced show and are WRONG for a visiting professional company. Added 2026-08-03 after the final Popcorn sweep made them pack-overridable. Without them the postshow tells a BoonDog audience that 'every production is made by volunteers' (untrue on these two nights) and invites them to 'say hello to the cast' (a one-woman touring show). See docs/cascade-prompts/2026-08-final-popcorn-sweep.md section 3.

thank_you.headline: Thank you for coming
thank_you.body: Touring theatre only reaches Coventry when people turn out for it. Thank you for giving Lovett your evening - and for giving a visiting company a full house to play to.
thank_you.footline: Lovett • BoonDog Theatre • 14-15 August 2026

criterion_charity.body: The Criterion is a registered charity with no paid employees - the building, the bar and the box office are run entirely by its members. Hosting touring work like tonight's is part of how we keep a stage open in Earlsdon.

bar.body: The bar is open until {{bar_close}}. Stay a while - have a drink and talk it over before you head off into the night.

press_quotes.quote: One of the most relentless, compelling pieces of work at the Fringe... An extraordinarily powerful hour.
An entirely disarming performance, precise, committed and unflinching... This production is one that you can really sink your teeth into.
This brilliant script, paired with even more powerful acting, had me mesmerised... As exciting and captivating as the biggest of productions.

_auth_comment: Carried across from _criterion-default on 2026-08-03, VERBATIM and byte-identical (popcorn-2026 carries the same three hashes, so the usual passcodes work unchanged). The operator resolves auth from the ACTIVE-SHOW pack, so a pack with no auth block means no login path at all: every passcode returns 'Invalid passcode' from server.py's /api/auth, because auth_config is an empty dict and no branch can match. This was predicted as a deploy-day trap and then hit for real on AURORA on 2026-08-03, the moment active-show.txt was switched to lovett-2026 for the Autopilot bench test - the 2026-07-16 lifecycle-smoke Finding 1 repeating for the second time. Fixed here in the pack rather than as a deploy-day step so it cannot be forgotten on 13 August. If the house passcodes are ever rotated, all three packs must change together.
